claims.statement: Actual CI+PC ordinary staging plus a sufficient paired nonlinear coupled J/H self-map, contraction, regularity, carrier-to-root sensitivity and convex Z invariant; native staging is not the nonlinear causal witness.

The frozen combined causal witness has a fresh source-only share, lossless signed both-role carrier/history transfer and readmission; geometry-uniform estimates prove unsplit/control obstruction and conditional exact-real return with W/Z evolving over the declared box.

The quadratic paired reference has independent full selected/restart J/H/S oracle comparisons, exact/proved carrier boundary admission, signed covariance, research lifecycle/replay/atomicity and a finite represented C/W/Z/J/H bridge retaining charge drift.
